script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title: A New Path

INT. JOHN'S LIVING ROOM - DAY

JOHN (40s, wearing a business suit), sits on the couch, staring at his resume. His wife, AMANDA (30s), enters the room, carrying a tray of coffee and pastries.

AMANDA
(cheerfully)
Morning, honey. I brought you some coffee and a croissant. You look like you could use it.

JOHN
(sighs)
I'm just not feeling it, Amanda. Another day of marketing feels like another day wasted.

AMANDA
(puts the tray on the coffee table)
I've heard that before. Why don't you try something new? You've always wanted to paint, right?

JOHN
(laughs)
That's a pipe dream, Amanda. I can't just quit my job and become an artist.

AMANDA
(sits beside him)
Why not? You're good at it. And I believe in you.

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

John and Amanda walk through the gallery, admiring the artwork.

ARTIST (50s, wearing an artist smock) approaches them.

ARTIST
(smiling)
Hi there. May I help you with something?

JOHN
(hesitant)
We were just admiring your work. It's truly inspiring.

ARTIST
(grateful)
Thank you. I've been an artist all my life. It's not an easy path, but it's worth it.

AMANDA
(to John)
See? You could do this.

INT. JOHN'S STUDIO - NIGHT

John sets up his easel and paints, feeling a renewed sense of purpose.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

John meets with an old colleague, SARAH (30s), for a catch-up.

SARAH
(surprised)
Wow, John. I didn't expect to see you here. I thought you quit marketing.

JOHN
(smiling)
I did. I've decided to pursue my art full-time.

SARAH
(impressed)
That's bold. I wish you the best of luck.

INT. JOHN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

John shows Amanda his latest painting.

JOHN
What do you think?

AMANDA
(tearfully)
It's beautiful, John. I'm so proud of you.

INT. ART CLASSROOM - DAY

John attends an art class, surrounded by other artists of all ages. He feels out of place but determined.

ART INSTRUCTOR (60s)
(approaching John)
Hello, new student. Don't be discouraged by the learning curve. Every artist starts somewhere.

INT. ART EXHIBIT - NIGHT

Months later, John's artwork is displayed in a gallery exhibition. He stands beside Amanda, beaming with pride.

JOHN
(whispering to Amanda)
I never thought this would be possible.

AMANDA
(smiling)
You just needed a push, John. And now, look at you.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
